reason: ₹22,000 is more than a month of what my whole house earns, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is too much when the crop money comes only twice a year. My wife washes by hand and it gets done, power or no power.
objection: A normal semi-automatic costs about half this, and I am paying the extra for a battery. If that battery dies after the warranty, who pays for a new one, and how much?
would_change_my_mind: If my brother-in-law or a neighbour bought one, used it for a full monsoon with the power cuts, and told me it works, and the dealer let me pay smaller instalments after harvest, around ₹12,000 to ₹14,000 total.
